info.title: Shelfy API
info.description: HTTP API of Shelfy Web. JSON in camelCase, timestamps in unix milliseconds. Errors are `application/problem+json` documents whose `code` is stable; clients map it to their own messages.

post.summary:
Approves a device sign-in for the signed-in account: the device that
shows this code gets a `migrate` token for this account's library, valid
7 days.
post.description:
Needs a sign-in or a re-authentication from the last 5 minutes (403
`reauth_required` otherwise). 400 `invalid_device_code` for a code that
is unknown, expired, used or approved by another account; approving a
code again is a no-op. Limit: 10 tries per 10 minutes per account (429).

204.description: Approved: the device's next poll gets its token.

post.summary: Asks whether a device sign-in was approved.
post.description:
`pending`: wait `interval` seconds and poll again. `slow_down`: the poll
came too soon; wait the new `interval`. `approved`: the `migrate` token,
delivered once; the codes stop working. 400 `invalid_device_code` for a
device code that is unknown, expired or used: start again. No cookie and
no CSRF headers are needed.

post.summary: Starts signing a device in: the migration CLI's `login`.
post.description:
Show the user `userCode` and `verificationUri` (or open
`verificationUriComplete`), then poll `POST /auth/device/poll` with
`deviceCode` every `interval` seconds until it is approved, for at most
`expiresIn` seconds. Limit: 10 requests per minute per client, shared
with the sign-in routes. No cookie and no CSRF headers are needed.

200.description: The codes of a new device sign-in.

post.summary:
Signs out: ends the session of the request's cookie and clears the
cookie. Answers 204 even without a session; without a session cookie the
answer sets no cookie.

204.description: Signed out; the session cookie, if sent, is cleared.

post.summary:
Signs out everywhere: ends every session of the signed-in user, this one
included, and clears the cookie.

204.description: Every session of the user ended; the session cookie is cleared.

post.summary: Emails a sign-in link to the address, if it belongs to an account.
post.description:
The answer is 202 whether or not the account exists, and whether or not
email is configured (see `GET /auth/methods`). The email carries the link
`<public url>/login/magic#<token>`. Limits: 10 requests per minute per
client and 3 per hour per address (429 `rate_limited` with
`Retry-After`). A malformed address answers 422 `validation_failed`.

202.description: Accepted. If the address has an account, a link valid for 15 minutes is on its way.

post.summary:
Redeems a sign-in link: the SPA page `/login/magic#<token>` sends the
token from its URL's fragment, which never reaches a server log.

204.description: Signed in: the response sets the session cookie.

get.summary: How a user can sign in on this instance.

200.description: The sign-in methods this instance offers.

post.summary: Finishes a passkey sign-in.
post.description:
A valid answer from a passkey of an active account starts a session
(replacing the one the browser held). Otherwise 400: `challenge_expired`
(the ceremony is unknown, used or older than 5 minutes: start again) or
`passkey_invalid` (the detail names the reason). Limit: as for `start`.

204.description: Signed in: the response sets the session cookie.

post.summary: Starts a username-less sign-in with a passkey.
post.description:
Pass `publicKey` to `navigator.credentials.get()`: the browser offers the
passkeys it holds for this site. Then send its answer with the
`ceremonyId` to `POST /auth/passkeys/login/finish`, within 5 minutes.
Limit: 10 sign-in requests per minute per client, shared with the other
sign-in routes. 404 when passkeys are off (see `GET /auth/methods`).

post.summary:
Finishes re-authenticating the session, with a passkey's answer or a
re-authentication link.
post.description:
After the 204, the routes that need a recent sign-in work for 5 minutes.
A passkey answer is refused with 400 `challenge_expired` (unknown, used,
expired or another session's ceremony) or `passkey_invalid`; a link that
is unknown, used, expired, of another kind or of another account, with
400 `invalid_link`, and stays unused.

post.summary: Starts re-authenticating the session.
post.description:
`passkey`: answers the options for `navigator.credentials.get()`, which
name the account's passkeys; send the answer with the `ceremonyId` to
`POST /auth/reauth/finish` within 5 minutes. 404 when the account has no
passkey, or passkeys are off.

`email`: emails a re-authentication link to the account's address and
answers 202. 404 when email is off (`GET /auth/methods`); the operator
can mint the link instead (`admin login-link --purpose reauth`). Limit:
3 emails per hour per address, shared with sign-in emails.

202.description: `email`: a link valid for 15 minutes is on its way.

post.summary: Reports an error caught by the web app.
post.description:
The report is logged for the operator; nothing is stored. Unknown fields
are refused: a report carries no post content.

get.summary: Every collection, in manual order, then creation order.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description:
The `ETag` of an earlier response. When the view has not changed since,
the answer is 304 with no body.

304.description: Unchanged since the ETag in `If-None-Match`; no body.

post.summary: Creates a collection; it comes last in the manual order.

Creates a collection holding the posts of a selector, in one step: "save
this view as a folder". Trashed posts are skipped.

Deletes a collection. Its posts stay in the library, out of the
collection.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The collection's id.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: What happens to the posts; default `label`.

patch.summary:
Renames, recolors or moves a collection. A platform folder keeps its
link.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The collection's id.

post.summary:
Adds posts to a collection: a list of keys, or every post a filter
lists (minus some), however many, in one step. Trashed posts and posts
already in the collection are skipped.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The collection's id.

delete.summary:
Takes one post out of a collection (§1.2 #12). Taking out a post that is
not in it changes nothing.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The collection's id.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The post's key.

get.summary: The realtime stream of the signed-in user.
get.description:
A `text/event-stream`. Every frame's `data:` is one line of JSON; the
`ServerEvent` schema maps each event name to its payload:

| `event:` | `data:` |
|---|---|
| `hello` | `HelloEvent`, first on every stream |
| `resync` | `ResyncEvent`: events were lost, reload everything |
| `posts.changed` | `PostsChangedEvent` |
| `stats.changed` | `StatsChangedEvent` |
| `job.updated` | `JobUpdatedEvent` |
| `notification` | `Notification` |

Published events carry an `id:`. To resume after a disconnection, send the
last one received as `Last-Event-ID` (`EventSource` does it when it
reconnects by itself) or as `lastEventId`: the missed events follow
`hello`, or `resync` when they are no longer kept (256 events, 5 minutes).
A fresh stream's `hello` carries the current position as its `id:`; a
resuming stream's `hello` has none. Keep the last non-empty
`lastEventId` seen.

A comment line comes after 20 s without a frame. The stream ends when the
server shuts down, and within 20 s of the end of its session (sign-out,
expiry); reconnect with backoff, and sign in again on 401.

parameters.name: topics
parameters.description: Only these events. Repeatable. Default: every topic.

parameters.name: lastEventId
parameters.description:
Resume after this event id, like `Last-Event-ID`; for clients that
reconnect with a new `EventSource`. The header wins when both are sent.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description:
The id of the last event received; `EventSource` sends it when it
reconnects by itself.

200.description: Server-sent events: `hello`, the missed events or `resync` when resuming, then live events; a heartbeat comment after 20 s without a frame.

X-Accel-Buffering.description: `no`: proxies must not buffer the stream.

get.summary: The user's jobs, newest first.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Only jobs of these kinds. Repeatable: any of them.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Only jobs in these states. Repeatable: any of them.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1–200 (larger values are clamped). Default 60.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `nextCursor` of the previous page.

get.summary: Every queue of the user, with its jobs counted by state.

post.summary:
Cancels a queued or running job: it never runs, or its worker is told
to stop. Cancelling a cancelled job changes nothing; a job that already
succeeded or failed answers 409 `conflict`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The job's id.

post.summary:
Queues a failed or cancelled job again, with every try available and its
error cleared. Any other state answers 409 `conflict`, as does a job
whose duplicate is already queued or running.
post.description: Send an `Idempotency-Key` to make a repeated click retry once.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The job's id.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description:
A key you choose for this request, 1–255 visible ASCII characters
(a UUID works). Sending the same request again with the same key
within 24 hours returns the first response, marked
`Idempotent-Replayed: true`, instead of acting twice. Reusing a key
for another request answers 422 `validation_failed`; while the first
request is still running, 409 `conflict`.

200.description: The job, queued again; or, for a repeated `Idempotency-Key`, the first response.

get.summary:
Who is signed in, what the account can do, and what it accepted. 401
`unauthorized` without a session: the SPA shows its sign-in page.

post.summary:
Records that the user accepted the disclaimer and the privacy notice of
these versions, now. Accepting again (a new version) replaces both, with
the new time. 422 for a malformed version.

get.summary: The account's passkeys, oldest first.

post.summary:
Adds a passkey to the account: finishes the registration that
`POST /me/passkeys/start` began in this session.
post.description:
400 `challenge_expired` (unknown, used, expired or another session's
ceremony: start again) or `passkey_invalid`; 409 `conflict` when the
credential is registered already; 422 for a label over 64 characters.

post.summary: Starts adding a passkey to the account.
post.description:
Needs a sign-in or a re-authentication from the last 5 minutes (403
`reauth_required` otherwise). Pass `publicKey` to
`navigator.credentials.create()`, then send its answer with the
`ceremonyId` to `POST /me/passkeys`, from this session, within 5 minutes.
404 when passkeys are off.

delete.summary: Removes a passkey from the account.
delete.description:
Needs a sign-in or a re-authentication from the last 5 minutes (403
`reauth_required` otherwise). Another account's passkey is a 404, like a
missing one. The passkey stays in the authenticator, which can no longer
sign in with it.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The passkey's id.

get.summary: The account's signed-in sessions, the current one flagged.

delete.summary: Signs out every session of the account but this one.

204.description: Every other session is signed out.

delete.summary:
Signs out one of the account's sessions: it stops working at once.
Signing out the current one is a sign-out, and clears the cookie. Another
account's session is a 404, like a missing one.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The session's id.

204.description: Signed out; for the current session, the cookie is cleared.

get.summary: The account's settings.

put.summary:
Changes some of the account's settings; answers all of them. A setting
that already has the value is not written again.

get.summary:
The account's working API tokens (not revoked, not expired), with their
last use.

post.summary:
Creates an API token for the extension or the iOS Shortcut; the answer
is the only time its value is shown.
post.description:
Needs a sign-in or a re-authentication from the last 5 minutes (403
`reauth_required` otherwise). 422 for the kind `migrate` (the migration
CLI signs in with the device flow), for scopes that are not the kind's,
or for a label over 64 characters; 409 `conflict` when the account holds
50 working tokens already.

201.description: The new token, with its value.

delete.summary:
Revokes one of the account's tokens: it stops working at once. Another
account's token, or one that no longer works, is a 404.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The token's id.

get.summary:
The storage the account uses and its quota, as last counted. When it was
never counted, the count starts now (`usage.recompute`).

200.description: The storage used and the quota.

post.summary: Starts installing an uploaded bundle (plan §4.1 step 5).
post.description:
Answers 202 with the install, polled at `Location`. 422 when the upload
is not a complete bundle database of this user; 409 when the web library
is not empty (merging arrives with P1-19) or another install runs.

post.summary: Which objects of a bundle the server lacks, so the CLI uploads only those.
post.description:
422 for more than 500 objects, a malformed hash or a type outside the
store's allowlist.

get.summary:
The state of an install, and its report once it succeeded. The install
runs in this server process: after a restart its id is unknown (404),
while the report stays in the installed library.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Install id.

The response is conditional: send the `ETag` back in `If-None-Match` and

post.description:
Give `ids`, or `upTo` to mark everything up to the newest notification

or by the post's stored shortcode.
post.description:
A signed-in session, or an API token with the `lookup` scope (the

Edits a post's note and tags, or its AI fields (a manual edit: the AI

post.summary: Creates an upload (tus creation).
post.description:
Answers 201 with `Location: /api/v1/uploads/{id}`. 412 without
`Tus-Resumable: 1.0.0`; 400 without a valid `Upload-Length`; 422 for bad
metadata; 413 when the length is over the purpose's limit (300 MiB for an
object, 4 GiB for a database); 409 with too many unfinished uploads.

parameters.name: Upload-Length
parameters.description: Length of the whole upload, in bytes.

parameters.name: Upload-Metadata
parameters.description:
Comma-separated `key base64(value)` pairs: `purpose`
(`migration-object` or `migration-db`), `sha256` (lowercase hex) and,
for an object, `ext`.

201.description: The upload exists; send its bytes with PATCH.

head.summary: Where an upload stands, so a client can resume it (tus core).
head.description:
200 with `Upload-Offset` and `Upload-Length`; no body, errors included:
412 without `Tus-Resumable: 1.0.0`, 404 for an unknown, expired or
another user's upload.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Upload id.

200.description: Where the upload stands; no body.

patch.summary: Appends bytes to an upload at its offset (tus core).
patch.description:
The body (`application/offset+octet-stream`, at most 16 MiB) goes at
`Upload-Offset`, which must be the upload's current offset (409
otherwise, with the current `Upload-Offset`). Bytes that arrive before a
connection breaks are kept. When the last byte arrives the server checks
the declared SHA-256 and type: a mismatch deletes the upload (422).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Upload id.

parameters.name: Upload-Offset
parameters.description: Where the body goes: the upload's current offset.

requestBody.description: The next bytes of the upload.

get.summary: The server's versions.
Liveness and readiness of the server.

200.description: The server is up and its database answers.

ApiToken.description: An API token of the account. Its value is never shown again.

expiresAt.description: When it stops working, unix ms; `null` until revoked.

lastUsedAt.description:
Last request it authenticated, unix ms (recorded at most once a
minute).

label.description: A name for the list, up to 64 characters; trimmed, and blank is none.

scopes.description: What it may do: some of the kind's scopes; all of them when left out.

ArchiveAssetTypes.description:
Which assets of a post are archived: the desktop's "asset types to
download".

ArchiveCounts.description: Archive work left for the workers (P1-19, P2), by class (OI-6, OI-7).

igCoverExpired.description:
Instagram covers whose URL has expired: extension `refresh_media`
tasks.

igCoverNoExpiry.description: Instagram covers whose URL has no expiry.

igCoverValid.description:
Instagram covers to archive whose signed URL is still valid: archive
them first, before they expire.

imageSlidesPending.description: Image slides without a stored image.

xCover.description: X covers to archive (they do not expire).

ArchiveState.description: Archive progress of a post's media (plan §2.13).

AuthMethods.description:
How a user can sign in on this instance; the sign-in page reads it before
anyone is signed in.

emailLink.description:
"Email me a link" works: an email transport is configured (E4: SMTP
is optional). Without it, the operator mints links with
`shelfy-server admin login-link`.

passkeys.description:
Passkeys work: the public URL is an https origin or localhost, with a
domain name. Says nothing about which accounts have passkeys.

userHandle.description: The user handle, base64url: required to sign in.

requireResidentKey.description: `true`, the WebAuthn Level 1 form of `residentKey: required`.

residentKey.description: `required`: a discoverable credential, for username-less sign-in.

Capabilities.description:
What the account can do on this server (plan §2.19). A capability turns
on with the phase that brings it; until then it is `false`.

emailLink.description:
"Email me a link" works: email is configured. Without it, sign-in and
re-authentication links come from the operator (`admin login-link`).

extension.description: The browser extension can pair and capture (P2).

passkeys.description:
Passkeys work on this server: sign-in, re-authentication and
registration (`GET /auth/methods` says the same before sign-in).

ClientErrorReport.description: An error caught by an error boundary of the web app.

clientVersion.description:
The web app's build version: at most 64 characters of letters,
digits, `.`, `+`, `-`, `_`.

componentStack.description: React's component stack; the first 8,000 characters are kept.

message.description:
The error's message; the first 1,000 characters are kept. Never put
post content in it.

name.description: The error's name (`TypeError`); the first 100 characters are kept.

occurredAt.description: When it happened, by the client's clock (unix ms).

route.description:
The route pattern of the view (`/p/:key`), never the URL: at most 200
characters, starting with `/`, without `?` or `#`.

stack.description: The JavaScript stack; the first 8,000 characters are kept.

view.description:
The view whose boundary caught the error (`gallery`, `postModal`,
`settings`): 1–64 characters of letters, digits, `.`, `_`, `-`, `:`.

Collection.description:
A collection ("source" in the UI): a manual one, or a saved folder or board
linked to a platform.

count.description: Posts in the collection, trash excluded.

externalId.description: Folder or board id on that platform.

id.description: Id, the value of the `collection` filter.

oneOf.description: Platform of a linked folder or board; `null` for a manual collection.

sourceName.description: Name of the folder or board when it was linked.

CollectionDeleteMode.description: What happens to the posts of a deleted collection.

CollectionDeleted.description: The outcome of deleting a collection.

trashed.description: Posts moved to the trash with the collection: 0 with `mode=label`.

CollectionFromQuery.description: A collection to create with posts.

selector.description: The posts to put in it: usually the current gallery filter.

CollectionList.description: Every collection, in manual order, then creation order.

CollectionPostRemoved.description: The outcome of taking a post out of a collection.

collection.description: The collection, with its new count.

removed.description: Whether the post was in the collection.

CollectionPostsAdded.description: The outcome of adding posts to a collection.

added.description:
Posts that joined the collection; trashed posts and posts already in
it are not counted.

collection.description: The collection, with its new count.

CollectionUpdate.description: Changes to a collection; absent fields are left alone.

name.description: The new name, 1–200 characters once trimmed.

position.description:
The new place in the manual order, from 0; past the end means last.
Every collection's `position` is renumbered from 0.

Consent.description: What the user accepted; `null` until accepted.

disclaimerAcceptedAt.description: When the disclaimer was accepted, unix ms.

privacyAcceptedAt.description: When the privacy notice was accepted, unix ms.

disclaimerVersion.description:
The version of the disclaimer the app showed (`2026-10`): 1–32
characters among `A–Z`, `a–z`, `0–9`, `.`, `_` and `-`.

privacyVersion.description: The version of the privacy notice the app showed (`1`), alike.

apiToken.description: The token as the list shows it.

token.description:
The value (`shx_…`), for `Authorization: Bearer`. Shown only now:
the server keeps its hash.

DeviceAuthorization.description:
What `POST /auth/device/start` answers: RFC 8628's device authorization
response, in camelCase.

deviceCode.description: The CLI's secret: it polls with it. Never show or log it.

userCode.description:
What the user approves: 8 letters as `XXXX-XXXX`; case, dashes and
spaces do not matter.

verificationUri.description: The page that approves it: `<public url>/device`.

verificationUriComplete.description: The same page with the code filled in: `<public url>/device#XXXX-XXXX`.

oneOf.description: Not approved yet: poll again in `interval` seconds.

interval.description: Seconds to wait before the next poll.

oneOf.description:
Polled sooner than the interval allows: wait `interval` seconds from
now on (it grew by 5).

interval.description: Seconds to wait before the next poll.

oneOf.description:
Approved: the token, valid 7 days, delivered once. Keep it in a file
only its owner can read.

expiresAt.description: When it stops working, unix ms.

tokenId.description: Its id, as the account's token list names it.

ErrorCode.description:
Stable, machine-readable error codes. Each one has a fixed HTTP status.

New codes may be added within `/api/v1`; existing ones never change meaning.

EventTopic.description:
The name of a published event; the `topics` filter selects by it.

`hello` and `resync` are not topics: every stream gets them.

field.description: The field, as named in the request (camelCase).

reason.description: Why the value was refused, for developers.

FilterParams.description:
The filters of `GET /api/v1/posts`, without paging or order. Every
filter is optional; the ones given combine with AND.

aiStatus.description: Only posts with this AI status.

oneOf.description:
Only posts with (`yes`) or without (`no`) AI tags; manual tags do not
count.

category.description: Only posts with this AI category.

concept.description:
Suggested concepts: more search terms, combined with `q` by
`conceptMode`. Repeatable in a query.

oneOf.description: How `q` and the concepts combine. Default `or`.

contentType.description: Only posts with this AI content type.

entity.description: Only posts with this AI entity.

mediaType.description: Only posts of these kinds: any of them. Repeatable in a query.

oneOf.description: Only websites (`web`) or only everything else (`social`).
Only posts with (`yes`) or without (`no`) a stored object.

tag.description: Only posts with this tag (the gallery's tag chip; always a filter).

tags.description:
Tags of the AI views, combined by `tagMode`. Repeatable in a query.
With `q` in `or` mode they widen the search.

trash.description: The trash instead of the library: `true` (or `1` in a query).

controlDb.description: The control database answers a query within 2 s.

HelloEvent.description: `hello`, the first event of every stream.

heartbeatMs.description:
Milliseconds between two heartbeat comments. A stream silent for much
longer is dead: reconnect.

lastEventId.description:
The id of the newest event of your stream when it opened: resume from
it (`Last-Event-ID` or `lastEventId`) to miss nothing after this point.

version.description: Version of the server build; a change means a new deploy.

alreadyStored.description: Already in the store (an earlier install, or another post's file).

fromUploads.description: Moved into the store from uploads.

errorCode.description:
Why the job failed (`failed`), or why its last try failed before a
retry. A stable code (`lease_expired`, `unavailable`, …), never prose.

finishedAt.description: When the job finished (succeeded, failed or cancelled).

maxAttempts.description: Tries allowed before the job fails for good.

postKey.description: The post the job works on, if one.

runAt.description: Not before this time (a delayed job, or the backoff before a retry).

stage.description: Current stage, a code, when the job has stages.

JobPage.description: One page of jobs, newest first.

nextCursor.description: Pass it as `cursor` to get the next page; `null` on the last page.

JobUpdatedEvent.description: `job.updated`: the latest state of a job, at most every 250 ms per job.

errorCode.description: Why the job failed (`failed`), or its last error before a retry.

postKey.description: The post the job works on, if one.

stage.description: Current stage, a code, when the job has stages.

JobsSummary.description:
Every queue of the user: each kind this server runs, and any other kind
the user has jobs of.

Language.description: A language of the app's interface.

trashed.description: Whether the saved post is in the trash.

LookupRequest.description: Ids of posts as a platform's own pages show them.

LookupResult.description: The saved posts among the ids asked for.

items.description:
One entry per id that names a saved post, in the order asked; ids of
no post are left out.

MarkReadRequest.description: Which notifications to mark read: exactly one of `ids` and `upTo`.

ids.description: These notifications, at most 200. Ids that do not exist are skipped.

upTo.description:
Every notification up to this id, included: "mark all read" with the
newest id shown, which leaves alone any that arrived since.

updated.description: Notifications that went from unread to read.

MatchMode.description: How several values of a list filter combine.

capabilities.description:
What the account can do on this server: the web app shows what it
can use and hides the rest.

consent.description: The disclaimer and privacy notice the user accepted.

MediaObject.description: A stored object (plan §2.13). Its URLs are same-origin and immutable.

durationMs.description: Duration of a video, when known.

g480Url.description:
The 480 px WebP rendition, `/media/<sha256>.g480.webp`; `null` when it
does not exist.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the bytes.

Migration.description: An install of a migration bundle.

MigrationReport.description: The reconciliation report of an install (plan §4.3): counts only.

bundle.description:
What `shelfy-migrate` counted in the desktop library and wrote to the
bundle, as it sent it.

durationMs.description: How long the install took, ms.

missing.description: The hashes the server does not have, in request order.

objects.description: The bundle's objects, at most 500 per request.

label.description:
The user's name for the passkey, up to 64 characters; trimmed, and
blank is none.

Notification.description:
A notification: an item of `GET /notifications` and the payload of the
`notification` event. It carries codes, not text: the client writes the
message from `kind`, `code` and `params`.

code.description: What happened (`job.failed`, …), stable like an error code.

id.description: Id; newer notifications have larger ids.

params.description: Values for the message; `{}` when there are none.

readAt.description: When it was marked read; `null` while unread.

target.description: Where the notification leads: a post key or an app route.

NotificationPage.description: One page of notifications, newest first.

nextCursor.description: Pass it as `cursor` to get the next page; `null` on the last page.

ext.description: Extension of its type in the store's allowlist (`jpg`, `webp`, `mp4`…).

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the content, lowercase hex.

lastUsedAt.description: Last sign-in or re-authentication with it, unix ms.

PasskeyAssertionStart.description:
The first answer of a sign-in or a re-authentication: the options to
sign with a passkey.

ceremonyId.description:
Names the ceremony in the call that finishes it: valid 5 minutes,
once.

PasskeyRegistrationStart.description: The first answer of a registration: the options to create a passkey.

ceremonyId.description:
Names the ceremony in `POST /me/passkeys`: valid 5 minutes, once,
in this session.

PlatformCounts.description: Posts per platform, every platform present.

Post.description: A post as the gallery shows it; `PostDetail` adds the heavy fields.

aiSaveReason.description: AI guess of why the post was saved.

aiStatus.description: AI lifecycle status; `null` when never analyzed.

authorName.description: Author display name (for websites: the title).

coverUrl.description: Remote cover URL; it may have expired.

deletedAt.description: When the post went to the trash; `null` outside the trash.

importedAt.description: When the post entered the library.

postUrl.description: Link to the original post (for websites: the final URL).

sortTs.description: Sort key of the newest/oldest orders: `postedAt`, else `importedAt`.

thumbhash.description: ThumbHash placeholder of the cover (≤ 25 bytes), standard base64.

oneOf.description: The current capture of a website.

items.description:
The posts, in the order of the keys asked for, each once. Keys of no
post are left out.

PostCount.description: The number of posts matching some filters.

total.description: Posts matching the filters, over all pages of `GET /posts`.

aiError.description: Code of the last AI error.

aiNextAt.description: Next AI attempt, when backed off.

aiSchemaVersion.description: Version of the AI output schema.

aiWeb.description: AI design catalog of a website, as produced.

PostDetail.description:
Everything about one post: the gallery fields plus the AI bookkeeping and
the tag and entity rows.

PostEntity.description: An AI entity of a post.

norm.description: Normalized form, the matching key of the `entity` filter.

label.description: Caption of the slide (file name, page title).

oneOf.description: The stored image, or the poster of a video.

sourceUrl.description: Remote URL of the slide; it may have expired.

nextCursor.description: Pass it as `cursor` to get the next page; `null` on the last page.

total.description:
Posts matching the filters, over all pages. Sent only with
`includeTotal=true`.

PostPatch.description:
Changes to a post. Every field is optional: absent fields are left
alone, and `null` clears one.

aiCategory.description: Manual AI edit: the category, at most 200 characters.

aiContentType.description: Manual AI edit: the content type, at most 200 characters.

aiDescription.description: Manual AI edit: the description, at most 20,000 characters.

aiEntities.description: Manual AI edit: the entities (at most 100, of at most 200 characters).

aiKeywords.description: Manual AI edit: the keywords (at most 100, of at most 200 characters).

aiLanguage.description: Manual AI edit: the language, at most 200 characters.

aiSaveReason.description: Manual AI edit: why the post was saved, at most 20,000 characters.

aiTags.description:
Manual AI edit: the AI tags, replacing the old ones (at most 100, of
at most 200 characters).

userNote.description: The user's note, at most 20,000 characters, stored as given.

userTags.description:
The user's tags, replacing the old ones: at most 100, of at most 200
characters. `null` clears them, like `[]`.

PostSelector.description: Which posts an action applies to: exactly one of `keys` and `filter`.

exceptKeys.description:
With `filter`: posts to leave out, by key, at most 1,000 ("select all
matching" minus the ones unticked).

filter.description:
Every post `GET /posts` lists with these filters, over all its pages
(`trash: true` selects in the trash).

keys.description:
These posts, by key, in the trash or not: at most 500. Unknown keys
are skipped.

PostSort.description: Order of a list of posts.

PostTag.description:
A tag of a post, after alias resolution. An AI tag and a manual tag with
the same name are two entries.

norm.description: Normalized form, the matching key of the `tag` and `tags` filters.

tier.description: `general` or `specific`, for AI tags with a tier.

PostsChangedEvent.description: `posts.changed`: reload the views that show these posts.

keys.description:
The posts that changed, at most 200. `null` when more changed, or the
change was not about listed posts: reload the whole view.

Problem.description: An error body: RFC 9457 problem details plus the stable `code`.

code.description: What went wrong. Clients map it to their own message.

detail.description: Developer-facing detail. Never UI prose, user content or secrets.

status.description: The HTTP status of the response.

title.description: The reason phrase of `status`. Not meant for display.

PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptionsJSON.description:
`PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptionsJSON`: what
`navigator.credentials.create()` needs to create a passkey.

authenticatorSelection.description: What kind of credential to create.

excludeCredentials.description:
The account's passkeys: an authenticator holding one of them does not
create another.

extensions.description:
Extension inputs (`credProps`, `credentialProtectionPolicy`, `uvm`);
a browser ignores those it does not know.

pubKeyCredParams.description: The key types accepted, preferred first: ES256 (-7), RS256 (-257).

timeout.description: How long the ceremony may take, ms.

user.description: The account the passkey is for.

PublicKeyCredentialRequestOptionsJSON.description:
`PublicKeyCredentialRequestOptionsJSON`: what
`navigator.credentials.get()` needs to sign with a passkey.

allowCredentials.description:
Empty to sign in: the browser offers the passkeys it holds for the RP
ID. The account's passkeys to re-authenticate.

extensions.description: Extension inputs (`uvm`); a browser ignores those it does not know.

rpId.description: The relying party ID: the public host name.

timeout.description: How long the ceremony may take, ms.

userVerification.description: `required`: the authenticator verifies the user (biometrics, PIN).

id.description: The RP ID: the public host name.
The user handle: 16 opaque bytes, base64url, stable per account.

name.description: The account's email, shown in the authenticator's account picker.

QueueResult.description: The outcome of an action on a queue.

affected.description:
What the action changed: 1 when pause or resume changed the queue
(0 when it already was so), the jobs cancelled, or the jobs deleted.

QueueSummary.description: One queue: a kind of job of the user.

paused.description: Whether the user paused it: its queued jobs wait.

oneOf.description: The answer of the passkey ceremony that `start` began.

token.description: The link's token: what follows `#` in its URL.

RenditionCounts.description: The `g480` renditions and ThumbHashes of the install.

failed.description: Images the pipeline could not decode.

notRenderable.description: Types the pipeline does not decode (AVIF, videos, PDF).

wanted.description: Objects the grid shows: covers, slides 1–3, site heroes.

ResyncEvent.description:
`resync`: events were lost. Reload every view (posts, stats, jobs,
notifications), then carry on with the stream.

reason.description: Why; the reaction is the same for every reason.

ResyncReason.description: Why a stream asks the client to reload everything.

items.description: The results of this page, best match first.

nextCursor.description: Pass it as `cursor` to get the next page; `null` on the last page.

total.description:
Posts matching the search, over all pages (not capped by the 1,000
results that relevance paging reaches).

ServerEvent.description:
Every event of `GET /api/v1/events`: `event` is the SSE event name and
`data` the JSON of its `data:` line. A type for clients; no response sends
this object as such.

Session.description: A signed-in session of the account.

current.description: Whether this is the session of the request.

expiresAt.description:
When it ends unless used again, unix ms: 30 days after its last use,
and never more than 90 days after sign-in.

id.description:
Its id, for `DELETE /me/sessions/{id}`: 32 hex digits, derived from
the session; it is not the cookie.

lastSeenAt.description: Last use, unix ms (recorded at most hourly).

userAgent.description: The browser's `User-Agent` at sign-in, cut to 256 bytes.

items.description: The current session first, then the most recently used.

Settings.description: The account's settings, defaults filled in.

archiveAssetTypes.description: The asset types to archive; all of them by default.

oneOf.description:
The interface language; `null` until chosen, when the app follows
the browser's.

SettingsUpdate.description:
Body of `PUT /api/v1/me/settings`: the settings to change; the others
keep their values. Other keys are refused (422).

archiveAssetTypes.description: The asset types to archive, all three.

dbUploadId.description: The complete upload (purpose `migration-db`) of the bundle's database.

merge.description:
Merge into a library that is not empty. Not supported yet: such a
library answers 409 either way.

Stats.description: Library counters. Trashed posts count only in `trashed`.

byMediaType.description: Posts per media type; types without posts are absent.

stored.description: Posts with at least one stored object (the `stored=yes` filter).

storedByKind.description: Posts per kind of stored object.

StoredByKind.description: Posts with a stored object of each kind.

images.description: At least one stored image slide.

id.description: Upload id (ULID); the upload's URL is `/api/v1/uploads/{id}`.

mediaBytes.description: The stored media (masters and kept videos), in bytes.

quotaBytes.description: The quota in bytes; 0 means unlimited (the owner).

updatedAt.description: When the use was counted, unix ms; `null` until the first count.

UserRole.description: What a user may do on the instance.

apiVersion.description: Major version of the API: the `1` of `/api/v1`.

WebCapture.description: The current capture of a website, without its page texts.

Problem.description: An error, as RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`.

bearer.description: A scoped API token (`shx_…`) of the extension, the iOS Shortcut or the migration CLI. Tokens cannot call routes that only accept the session.

session.name: __Host-shelfy_session
session.description: The web app's session, set by signing in. Requests that change state (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE) with this cookie must also send `X-Shelfy-Client: web` and an `Origin` equal to the public URL; otherwise they fail with 403 `csrf_failed`. A request with an `Authorization` header is never authenticated by this cookie.

tags.name: platform
tags.description: Health, the API description, the realtime stream, notifications, client error reports and the version.

tags.name: auth
tags.description: Sign-in with passkeys and links, re-authentication, sessions and sign-out, and the migration CLI's device sign-in.

tags.name: account
tags.description: The signed-in user: profile and capabilities, settings, consent, storage use, sessions, passkeys and API tokens.

tags.name: library
tags.description: The signed-in user's posts, stats and collections, and their edits.

tags.name: search
tags.description: Ranked search over the signed-in user's library.

tags.name: migration
tags.description: Moving a desktop library: resumable uploads (tus 1.0) and the install.

tags.name: jobs
tags.description: The signed-in user's background jobs and their queues: progress, cancel, retry, pause and resume.
